hypothesis: Keep independent full-output XML validation; parse actual changed cells while omitting writer-proven unchanged cell spans and reusing their immutable semantics. Fully parse membership-changing existing rows; fallback for new rows or shared-formula worksheets.

allocation.scope: staged sets and MultiSourceEdit::commit; no publication/reopen/oracles

profile.scope: Separate zero-before/dump-after/toggle exact-name; fourth call only, preceding3lifecyclecalls retained

admission: Require at least 5% p50 improvement in primary total and commit phase in both paired repeats for both medium and dense-sparse, with exact output/semantic/provider oracles. Require at least 15% commit Ir reduction in both shapes/repeats as independent mechanism confirmation. Flag every >5% adverse latency, mean, RSS or incremental allocation peak by individual row; review all flags. Reject if meaningful primary gate fails. No cold/range/native-producer/scaling claim.
native_order: retained baseline native-r2 under candidate source checkout
retained_baseline_custody: Retained baseline binary and build manifest remain hash-bound; candidate checkout source is independently bound during final A2 and differs only in the frozen candidate file inventory.
resource_scope: Existing source/Part budgets, output byte bounds, execution checks and publication charges retained. New reconstruction scratch is operation-local and fallibly reserved. Allocation measurements report calls/bytes and incremental region peak separately.

hardware.scope: Whole fresh child including corpus/setup/publication/oracles; diagnostic only, not isolated commit counters.

candidate_source_binding: Exact source file inventory and SHA256 values captured independently for each stage; candidate diff must be nonempty and entirely within candidate_source_roots. Harness source is identical. Review exact production/test patch before application.
